deadline.value: Graduate applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, with no set deadline.
deadline.quote: For Clarkson University's programs, there are no set deadlines for graduate admissions. Instead, we review applications on a rolling basis.

gre_general.value: The general GRE is required; a score of 319 is recommended for applicants seeking assistantships.

also.quote: A GRE score of at least 319 is recommended (minimum verbal score of 156 and minimum quantitative score of 163).

gre_subject.value: The GRE Physics Subject Test is not required but is recommended.
gre_subject.quote: GRE Physics Subject Test scores are not required but are recommended.

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a faculty agreement is needed before admission.

funding.value: Most current students hold a teaching or research assistantship that covers tuition and a living stipend.
funding.quote: Most current graduate students are supported by Teaching Assistantships or Research Assistantships.

also.quote: A full appointment covers the 30 credit hours of tuition and provides a stipend that covers estimated living expenses.

entry_route.value: A BS or equivalent in physics or a closely related subject is the stated prerequisite.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must have a BS or equivalent degree in physics or a closely related subject.

ielts_min.value: Applicants seeking a TA or RA need 7.0 in each IELTS band, with at least 7.5 in Speaking; the university minimum is 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: International applicants should have a minimum score of 26 in each section of the TOEFL, 7.0 on each band of the IELTS (with a minimum Speaking band of 7.5)

notes: Department rule applies to TA/RA applicants: 26 in each TOEFL section and 7.0 in each IELTS band. MS students who want the PhD sit a placement test; up to 30 MS credits can transfer.
